subject: gk
question: Which of the following is NOT a basic feature of the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Drawn from one source**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian Constitution is known for its **blend of rigidity and flexibility**, allowing for amendments while maintaining core principles.
 
• It is the **lengthiest written constitution** in the world, containing numerous articles and schedules.
 
• The Constitution establishes a **parliamentary system** of government, where the executive is accountable to the legislature.
 
• It is **not drawn from one source**; rather, it incorporates elements from various other constitutions around the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Constitution of India was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on **26th November 1949** and came into effect on **26th January 1950**.
 
• It lays down the framework defining fundamental political principles, establishes the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and the duties of citizens.
 
• The Constitution declares India a sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic, assuring its citizens justice, equality, and liberty, and endeavors to promote fraternity.
 
• The Seventh Schedule of the Constitution contains three lists which delineate the subjects under the Union, State, and Concurrent lists.
 
• Amendments to the Constitution can be made through a process outlined in Article 368.
